policy_and_cost.network_policy: Host fetch guard permits loopback only. Worker adapter accepts one fixed Privy-shaped URL and redirects it to the validated loopback fixture. No live Privy API call.
policy_and_cost.budget: Existing Cloudflare subscription only; no separately billed provider operation authorized or executed.
policy_and_cost.observed_cost: n/a: local workerd and local test HTTP only; no provider billing measurement.

cleanup_result: Alchemy build log records deletion. Independent lsof inspection after the final run found no listener on TCP 19735. No private keys or authorization headers retained.
limitations_and_next_action: Pass applies only to the bounded local primitives and adapter. Ethereum message signing only; no SDK oracle, live sandbox app, Privy signature acceptance, quorum membership or enforcement, actual policy refusal, Solana signing, user-key retrieval, nested quorums, hosted runtime, transaction signing or broadcast was tested. Identify the sandbox and intended co-signers and obtain a separately authorized provider budget before a live call. Creation-response decoding retains only the documented fields consumed by this spike; it is not a full Privy SDK. Request-expiry headers and authenticated user-key retrieval are not implemented. The loopback response is deliberately synthetic and is not a wallet signature.
